data.title: Bayline and Avonlea
data.about:
Bayline and Avonlea at Rashid Yachts and Marina offers modern luxury living at its finest. Nestled in the heart of Rashid Yachts and Marina, this remarkable property features a range of beautifully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 3-bedroom duplexes. Bayline seamlessly combines the tranquility of waterfront living with the vibrant cultural allure of Dubai.

Designed for the discerning homeowner, Bayline and Avonlea by Emaar is a fusion of opulence, convenience, and nature's serenity. Enjoy daily escapes from the ordinary with an expansive central pool that mirrors the ambiance of world-class resorts. Surrounding landscaped parks create a perfect urban-nature balance. Just a leisurely stroll away, the Marina Promenade awaits, offering a carefully curated selection of retail and dining experiences to complement every occasion.

characteristics_module.title: Resort-Style Living in Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Choice of masterfully detailed and expansive 1-, 2-, 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom duplexes.
  • Panoramic windows provide endless outdoor living space views.
  • Cutting-edge platform offering a variety of world-class amenities.
  • Contemporary residential oasis design for tranquil surroundings.
  • Premier residences thoughtfully designed with elegance and style.
  • Proximity to beautiful dining, retail, shopping, cultural, and leisure experiences.

location_tile.title: A Thriving Promenade
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Bayline and Avonlea resides within the prestigious Rashid Yachts and Marina, offering a lavish residential retreat complete with contemporary amenities, picturesque landscapes, and convenient access to thrilling local destinations. Situated in the heart of Rashid Yachts & Marina, it provides an ideal setting for relaxation and exploration, all while being within close reach of some of Dubai's most captivating attractions.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 20 Mins to Dubai International Airport
  • 22 Mins to Downtown Dubai
  • 22 Mins to Al Sabka Gold Souq
  • 32 Mins to Dubai Marina
